newsitem.title: USA: Stride Rite seen as takeover target - report.
newsitem.headline: Stride Rite seen as takeover target - report.

text.p: Shoemaker Stride Rite Corp may be a takeover target from an apparel maker, a California investment manager told Business Week's "Inside Wall Street" column.
The unnamed apparel maker is expected to make a bid in the mid-$20 range for Stride Rite, which closed at 13-3/4, the investment manager told the magazine.

Stephen Velgot, an analyst at Monness, Crespi, Hardt, likes the stock because it is turning its operations around and recently reached alliances with Levi Strauss and London Fog Industries, Business Week said.
